info.title: Hillel Qauto
info.description:
Api docs for hillel-qauto project 
To get a session cookie you need to request api/auth/signup or api/auth/signin routes
        and to receive successful response. In this way session cookie named "sid" will be set.

get.summary: Ends up user session. Clears session cookies.

201.description: Creates user, user profile and user settings, and authenticates created user.

post.summary: Sends password reset instructions to the specified email

get.summary: Sends an email with new password to the user's email

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Generated hash string which identifies reset password session and stored in database. Deleted after expiration.

delete.summary: Deletes user's account and current user session

get.summary: Gets current user car by id
